newsitem.title: USA: Fund investors favor Dole - survey.
newsitem.headline: Fund investors favor Dole - survey.

text.p: Republic presidential candidate Bob Dole easily topped President Bill Clinton in a poll of mutual fund investors conducted by a fund trade group.

Dole was cited by 53 percent of respondents, Clinton by 38 percent, Ross Perot by six percent, and Libertarian Party candidate Harry Browne three percent, according to the Mutual Fund Educational Alliance.
The group said 605 persons responded to a survey it conducted on its Internet web site from Sept 3 to Oct 3. The survey had a margin of error of plus or minus 10 percent.
The poll asked: "Which candidate's election would give you the most confidence as a mutual fund investor?"
